/** Kernel primitives every component builds on (SCRIPT_MODEL §4.1). */
export const CORE_PRIMITIVE_TYPES = ['box', 'button', 'webService'] as const;

/**
 * Library components shipped by `@verbis/components` (roadmap step 27). The validator treats
 * these plus `componentRegistry` entries as known; callers can pass a narrower or wider set.
 */
export const LIBRARY_COMPONENT_TYPES = [
  'text',
  'heading',
  'scriptText',
  'privacyNotice',
  'explicitConsent',
  'richContent',
  'alert',
  'divider',

  'transferHint',

  'image',
  'video',
  'iframe',
  'countdown',
  'note',
  'badge',
  'progressIndicator',
  'signature',
] as const;

export const BUILTIN_COMPONENT_TYPES: readonly string[] = [
  ...CORE_PRIMITIVE_TYPES,
  ...LIBRARY_COMPONENT_TYPES,
];

/** Props that would carry display text; they must be `*Key` i18n references instead. */
export const LITERAL_TEXT_PROPS: readonly string[] = [
  'text',
  'label',
  'title',
  'placeholder',
  'helperText',
  'description',
  'content',
  'message',
];
